title: 1859 Shamakhi earthquake
summary: The English Wikipedia article "1859 Shamakhi earthquake", at revision 1370150467, opens: "The 1859 Shamakhi earthquake struck Shamakhi in the Baku Governorate of the Russian Empire, on 11 June. The earthquake had an estimated magnitude of 5.9 and caused moderate damage and killed approximately 100 people." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4522773, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Earthquake in Azerbaijan". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
